about: Every published version of the LBK client plugin. Any change to the plugin's files needs a new version and a new entry here (src/__tests__/plugin-release.test.ts enforces it), then client-plugin/publish.sh. Clients who added the marketplace (hackeyzlife02/lbk-plugin) get it automatically; anyone who uploaded the plugin file has to upload the new one. Rules for assistants are not plugin changes: they live in src/mcp/guidance.ts and reach every client on the next deploy.

releases.changes: Crisp icon: assets/icon.png (512) and assets/logo.png (1024) re-rendered from the vector LBK monogram (brand/lbk-icon.svg) as a full-bleed, opaque navy square. Fixes the white corners and blur George saw.

Thin plugin: the skill and commands now say 'use LBK first, call get_my_account, follow its guidance'. All the detailed rules (what to use when, pricing, the showroom, voice) moved to the connector's live get_my_account guidance, so rule changes no longer need a plugin update. No spec book wording (from 0.2.1).
